answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 31474 Country: India Title: I have a decision regarding decision making. Question: I have a decision regarding decision making. I am usually confused and gets really tense and anxious in any decision i take. I am always affraid during any decision. I also Do Istikhara but mostly do not get any clerity and continue to be confused during decision. and after taking the decision also I continue to get affraid. Kindly suggest me some wazifa, which will help me with strong decision making and remove my confusion, anxities. Jazak Allah Answer ID: 31474 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 610/510/B=1432) Recite durood 100 times daily, لا حول ولا قوۃ الا باللہ العلی العظیم 500 times and then supplicate to Allah, in-sha-Allah your problem will go away. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
